title: Build & runtime
summary: Build, validate, and run the verified Velclaw application stack.

sections.heading: Verified stack
body: Velclaw 2.0.0 uses Next.js 16.3.3, React 19.2.1, TypeScript 5.9.x, and a pnpm v9 lockfile. The application exposes both Next.js and legacy Node server entry points in package.json.

sections.heading: Build consistently
body: The package defines webpack-based Next.js development and production builds.

examples.code:
pnpm build
pnpm lint
pnpm type-check

sections.heading: Run workloads
body: The primary runtime is Next.js. package.json also defines a legacy:start script for server/index.js. Runtime configuration can depend on environment variables and external services.

sections.heading: Continuous integration
body: GitHub Actions contains Node.js CI, a Next.js workflow, and a Velclaw review workflow. The Node.js workflow currently tests Node 18.x, 20.x, and 22.x.
